entries.title: Track stock by Part
entries.description: Configure how each Part is stocked, record opening balances and revaluations, and review its complete movement history with clearer stock and cost warnings.

entries.title: Control inventory access
entries.description: Inventory and cost permissions now keep sensitive pricing hidden while still allowing stores staff to manage stock.

entries.title: Check out and return Job stock
entries.description: Issue stock to Jobs and record unused quantities returned to store, with availability and commitment information shown during the workflow.

entries.title: Manage purchase orders through receiving
entries.description: Create, edit, send, cancel, and print purchase orders, then record partial, complete, or excess deliveries. Partially received orders can also be closed short when the remaining quantity will not arrive.

entries.title: Print barcode labels
entries.description: Generate printable barcode labels for Parts, including directly from received purchase order lines.

entries.title: Build Parts from components
entries.description: Define bills of materials for internally built Parts and post builds that consume component stock and add the completed quantity at its derived cost.

entries.title: Close out completed Jobs
entries.description: Use the close-out queue to find completed Jobs with outstanding stock, resolve their remaining quantities, and prevent further stock issues after close-out.

entries.title: Work through inventory tasks more reliably
entries.description: Inventory tables, selectors, quantity validation, negative-stock warnings, number formatting, purchase-order PDFs, and several workflow messages now behave more consistently.

entries.title: Open guidance for your current task
entries.description: A persistent Help link now opens public documentation relevant to the area you are using when documentation is configured.

entries.title: Open help from any screen
entries.description: Use the new Help action in screen headers to open the public documentation in your browser when documentation is configured.
